content: Following recent works, we compare on two widely used datasets, the Penn Treebank (PTB) BIBREF28 as prepared by BIBREF29 and WikiText2 (WT-2) BIBREF20 . For both datasets, we follow the same training, validation, and test splits as in BIBREF0 .
